tasks.title: Conversation #61
tasks.transcript:
Man: How was the photography workshop last week?
Woman: We learned techniques for taking portraits. Next week we'll do action photography.
Man: That sounds so interesting. I've always wanted to take pictures of tennis matches.
Woman: The instructor who will lead the class next week has photographed state championships in six different sports.
Man: I'd love to attend. I'll buy a new camera for the occasion. Are all ability levels welcome?
Woman: Yes, I'll e-mail you the link to sign up. Just be aware that spots are going fast.

questions.stem: Why does the man want to attend a workshop?

options.A: He is photographing the state tennis championships.
options.B: He is assisting with his school's portrait day.
options.C: He wants to learn about sports photography.
options.D: He wants advice on purchasing a new camera.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 男人为什么想参加工作坊？ 定位原文: “I’ve always wanted to take pictures of tennis matches.” 选项分析: A. “He is photographing the state tennis championships.”（他正在拍摄州立网球锦标赛。）他并没有提到自己在拍摄比赛，只是说想拍摄网球比赛，因此A选项错误。 B. “He is assisting with his school's portrait day.”（他在协助学校的肖像日。）没有提到学校肖像日，因此B选项错误。 C. “He wants to learn about sports photography.”（他想学习体育摄影。）他确实提到自己想拍网球比赛，这与学习体育摄影一致，因此C选项正确。 D. “He wants advice on purchasing a new camera.”（他想要关于购买新相机的建议。）他提到要购买新相机，但主要目的是为了参加摄影工作坊，而不是为了买相机，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman imply about a workshop?

options.B: It covers the same topic every week
options.C: It is intended for advanced photographers.

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 女人对工作坊有什么看法？ 定位原文: “Just be aware that spots are going fast.” 选项分析: A. “It was not helpful.”（它不太有帮助。）并没有提到工作坊是否有帮助，因此A选项错误。 B. “It covers the same topic every week.”（它每周都讨论相同的话题。）没有提到工作坊内容的重复性，因此B选项错误。 C. “It is intended for advanced photographers.”（它适合高级摄影师。）并没有提到工作坊的难度，因此C选项错误。 D. “It is very popular.”（它非常受欢迎。）她提到名额很快就会满，暗示工作坊很受欢迎，因此D选项正确。
